cover.headline: Translation: buy ads
cover.sub: What a reach drop after an algorithm update really asks for, and the channel you own.

intro.headline: Reach you own vs reach you rent

blocks.text: Platforms make money selling attention. When your organic reach drops, the fix they offer is **paid reach**.
Before boosting a post, ask what you keep once the ad stops.

slides.headline: Use ads to grow the list

blocks.text: If you do pay, pay for **signups**, not likes. A follower can vanish in the next update. An email stays.
Point ads at a signup page with one offer, like an early listen or presale access.

left.title: Boosted post
left.text: Reaches people while the budget lasts.

right.title: Email
right.text: Reaches every subscriber, every time you send.

blocks.text: Email release news to the list first. Post it on social after that.
Fans who joined the list deserve something the feed doesn't get: **first access**, a code, a voice note.
Give list members a 24-hour head start on every presale.
